fact: In 2018, 37 of 218 communes reported using budget-management software (ELBELEDI) and the other communes managed their financial operations manually; 143 communes (65.78%) kept a payment register and 75 had neither software nor register.
title: Rapport sur les capacités institutionnelles des communes mauritaniennes
publisher: Ministère de l'Intérieur et de la Décentralisation, Direction Générale des Collectivités Territoriales
